# Retired dependency-audit exception: PYSEC-2026-3552

## Status

Removed for the `0.2.0rc3` validation line on 2026-09-03.

## Resolution

- Package: `cryptography`
- Previously validated vulnerable version: `49.0.0`
- Advisory: `PYSEC-2026-3552`
- Aliases: `GHSA-g6cj-pr64-35w5`, `CVE-2026-69247`
- Advisory fixed version: `50.0.0`
- DecisionLock validated target: `50.0.1`

The Security workflow no longer passes `--ignore-vuln PYSEC-2026-3552`. Dependency auditing must
therefore fail if the fixed runtime profile regresses to an affected version.

The static source scan continues to reject the affected `pkcs7_decrypt_*` APIs as defense in depth;
removing the temporary package-version exception does not weaken that source-level control.

## Historical applicability assessment

The advisory affected PKCS#7 decryption APIs that DecisionLock did not use. The temporary exception was
narrowly scoped while a validated fixed major release was unavailable. Its documented removal
condition was `cryptography>=50.0.0`; that condition has now been met and the exception is closed.
